title: Digital Tire Tread Depth Gauge – LCD Display
descriptionHtml:
Keep an eye on your tires – keep an eye on safety

Too little tread on the tires is dangerous and can result in fines at an inspection. It's hard to tell with the naked eye when it's time to replace them.

Accurate measurement in seconds

With the digital gauge you see the tread depth precisely on the large LCD screen. You quickly get an answer on whether the tires hold up or need replacing.

Features

  • Digital readout with a large LCD screen
  • Measures 0–25.4 mm
  • Shows in both mm and inches
  • For car, truck and motorcycle
  • Small and easy to keep in the car

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
